name: Knight Errand
summary: A chess-knight route puzzle in a tiled courtyard: leap in L-shapes to light every lantern and match par
about: An old city courtyard at dusk with arched walls, swinging lanterns and a tiled board in lapis and ivory, framed in a saffron border. A carved wooden knight leaps in arcs, leaves a dotted trail and lights each lantern it lands on; planters block squares and a caged lantern only opens once you fetch the brass key. Ten errands from 5 by 5 to 8 by 8 are generated from fixed seeds and checked by a solver, so every one is solvable and its par is the true shortest route.
how: A demo errand plays on load; press Start the errands, Take the reins or click any square to take over.
Click a glowing square to leap there; hover shows the L-shaped route. Arrow keys move the cursor and Enter leaps.
Land on every lantern; take the brass key first to open the caged one. Planters cannot be landed on.
Match par for three stars; you have par plus four moves. U undoes, H shows the next best leap (two stars at most).
R restarts the errand, P pauses the clock, and the errand medallions let you replay any unlocked errand.
Stars and your best total are saved on this device, and reduced motion removes the leaps and glows.
